about: Oldest supported mobile client contract (P19.S3.T1, MIGRATION-COMPAT-01): the operations the mobile app at commit 362db5b (2026-10-10) calls, with the request and response schemas it was built against. Generated by extract_mobile_contract.py; do not edit.

schema.title: Response Chapter Lessons V1 Chapters  Chapter Id  Lessons Get
Response Published Exam Profiles V1 Exam Profiles Get
Response List Articles V1 Help Articles Get

Response List Sessions V1 Me Sessions Get
Response Mock Sessions V1 Mock Sessions Get

device_check.description: How the trial decision was made on this platform
device_check.title: Device Check

device_state.description: Set when this app installation must be added to the trial before protected trial use
device_state.title: Device State

has_access.description: True when a current entitlement allows new practice and written tests
has_access.title: Has Access

weights.description: Written allowance units per question type
weights.title: Weights

fallback_locale.description: True when the requested language had no version, so English is shown
fallback_locale.title: Fallback Locale

cutoff_at.description: C = D + T: the server admits no writes after this
cutoff_at.title: Cutoff At

questions.description: Approved, published question families available for practice
questions.title: Questions

label.description: A name the learner recognises, e.g. 'My phone'
label.title: Label

proof.description: Provider evidence (DeviceCheck/App Attest or Play Integrity), when available
proof.title: Proof

CorrectionLink.description: A reviewed correction of the reported question (P12.S1.T3, REPORT-LINKS-01).
CorrectionLink.title: CorrectionLink

replaces.description: Self-service replacement of a registered device
replaces.title: Replaces

scope.description: chapters: the chosen chapters; half_book: first or second half of the book by chapter order; full_book: every chapter of this class's book; combined: the same subject's Class XI and XII books
scope.title: Scope

related_lessons.description: Published lessons for this question's topic (or its chapter): revise here
related_lessons.title: Related Lessons

ItemSnapshot.description: What a learner sees during an attempt. Keys and explanations are never part of this payload.
ItemSnapshot.title: ItemSnapshot

available_languages.description: Languages with a reviewed, published variant of this lesson
available_languages.title: Available Languages

concept_id.description: The lesson concept; its language variants share it
concept_id.title: Concept Id

locked.description: True when the caller has no active plan or trial; body and pages are withheld
locked.title: Locked

requested_language_missing.description: True when the language asked for has no reviewed variant; another is shown
requested_language_missing.title: Requested Language Missing

positions.description: The original test's question numbers this test repeats, in order
positions.title: Positions

entitled.description: Whether this learner can start a new test now (an active plan or trial)
entitled.title: Entitled

op_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key for this operation
op_id.title: Op Id

revision.description: Monotonic per position on the client
revision.title: Revision

replay.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier identical request
replay.title: Replay

PageOut.description: One logical page: a photo, or one page of a PDF. Mapping and the page cap count these.

content_type.description: Type of the uploaded original; the page itself is served as a PNG preview
content_type.title: Content Type

file_id.description: The uploaded file this page came from
file_id.title: File Id

file_pages.description: How many pages the file has (1 for a photo)
file_pages.title: File Pages

size.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes
size.title: Size

PageOut.title: PageOut

ProfileIn.description: Onboarding answers (P04.S3.T1). Everything can be corrected later; no identity documents are collected.
ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn

earned_units.description: Null unless scored; no mark is invented for unassessed work
earned_units.title: Earned Units

learner_action.description: What the teacher asked you to do for this pending question
learner_action.title: Learner Action

status_reason.description: Why a question is pending or unavailable
status_reason.title: Status Reason

criteria.description: Optional: disputed criterion ids per question position
criteria.title: Criteria

eligible_positions.description: Questions that can be disputed now (when available)
eligible_positions.title: Eligible Positions

positions.description: Questions in the open request (when requested)
positions.title: Positions

target_version.description: The released version a request targets
target_version.title: Target Version

window_ends_at.description: 14 days after the disputed result was released
window_ends_at.title: Window Ends At

windows.description: Per eligible question: when its appeal window ends (OCT8-04)
windows.title: Windows

credited.description: Questions credited to everyone after review
credited.title: Credited

excluded.description: Questions withdrawn after review: not counted at all
excluded.title: Excluded

revised_at.description: When this score was revised after review (v2+)
revised_at.title: Revised At

sections.description: Mocks: one row per pattern section
sections.title: Sections

SourceRef.description: Where a chapter/topic lives in the owner's original file (PDF pages are 1-based file indices).
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

reconciliation.description: Operations presented after finalisation, with their outcome
reconciliation.title: Reconciliation

same_request.description: False when the attempt was finalised by another request or by expiry
same_request.title: Same Request

corrections.description: Reviewed corrections of the question you reported
corrections.title: Corrections

ends_at.description: The trial's original end; never extended by a device decision
ends_at.title: Ends At

evidence.description: What device evidence was available, e.g. provider_unconfigured
evidence.title: Evidence

duplicate.description: The same file was already uploaded to this script; it was reused
duplicate.title: Duplicate

pages.description: The logical pages this file added, in order
pages.title: Pages

linked_from.description: Set when this is a new practice attempt linked to an earlier test

upload_cutoff_at.description: U = D + G: nothing is admitted after this
upload_cutoff_at.title: Upload Cutoff At

writing_deadline_at.description: D: writing should stop (not enforceable at home)
writing_deadline_at.title: Writing Deadline At

review_accepting.description: False means teacher marking is at capacity; new tests can't start now
review_accepting.title: Review Accepting

review_staffed.description: False means no funded teacher review exists, so nothing is offered
review_staffed.title: Review Staffed

questions.description: Reviewed written questions with a published rubric
questions.title: Questions

WrittenItemOut.description: What the learner sees: the question and its marks. Rubrics are never part of this payload.
WrittenItemOut.title: WrittenItemOut

awaiting_regrade.description: Questions a teacher will re-mark under a corrected marking guide (current marks stand until then)
awaiting_regrade.title: Awaiting Regrade

completeness.description: Not complete means no final total: some questions are pending or could not be assessed
completeness.title: Completeness

history.description: Every released version, oldest first; corrections never erase history
history.title: History

linked_attempts.description: New practice tests linked to this one (W04.S3.T3); they never change this result
linked_attempts.title: Linked Attempts

notices.description: Changes to this result's basis, such as a marking-guide correction
notices.title: Notices

scored_max_units.description: Maximum of the questions that were scored
scored_max_units.title: Scored Max Units
